Candidate files (uncommitted; byte-identical to the checkout, verified by program):
  <repo path>   <size> bytes   SHA-256 <complete 64-character hash>

Evidence tier (Protocol section 10): <local/simulated tests | static review | live>. The reviewer has not run the tests unless it says so.

The reviewer's reply should echo, on a line starting REVIEW OF:, the exact HANDOFF header it reviewed, and give its technical review under "For Claude" and a plain-language explanation under "For <developer>".
